acceptance_criteria.description: A fresh initialized fixture passes doctor with integration.manifest and integration.debug-registration ready, while existing provider drift and unrelated-content tests remain fail-closed and attribution-aware.
Package contract tests invoke pnpm correctly whether npm_execpath/PUMAREJO_PNPM_CLI is a command name or a JavaScript path, with shell disabled.
Init tests assert the deterministic five base entries plus the curated provider allowlist, and the forged-manifest remove test again proves no deletion occurs.
The exact provider-focused suite, build, and pack dry-run pass.

closed_decisions: Keep the approved curated bundled provider, project-relative Cargo path, per-file attribution, atomic staging, fail-closed doctor, and exact-file removal design unchanged.
Doctor must compare staged provider contents with the current curated package bundle and must report a fresh unchanged initialization as ready.
Package contract tests must support npm_execpath values that are either an executable command such as pnpm or a JavaScript CLI path, on Windows and non-Windows hosts, without shell interpolation.
The fresh-init manifest contains five non-provider changes plus exactly PROVIDER_SOURCE_ALLOWLIST.length provider changes; assertions should express that invariant rather than a magic total.
The forged-manifest removal test must initialize successfully, forge an unsafe entry, and prove removal rejects before mutating the target file.

focused: pnpm vitest run tests/unit/provider-source.test.ts tests/unit/attributed-drift.test.ts tests/integration/init.test.ts tests/integration/remove.test.ts tests/integration/doctor.test.ts tests/contract/package.test.ts tests/release/release-safety.test.ts tests/platform/cargo-proof.test.ts tests/platform/provider-proof.test.ts

forbidden_changes: Do not edit provider source, provider staging/removal production logic other than the missing doctor import, public MCP/dialog behavior, process custody, dependencies/lockfiles, docs, queue/blocker/release files, git, Jira, or pull requests.
Do not weaken fail-closed provider hash, path, symlink, attribution, or removal checks.
Do not use shell=true or interpolate package-manager commands into a shell string.
objective: Repair the bounded provider delivery gate failures without changing the approved delivery design: restore doctor hash verification, make package tests invoke pnpm portably, and correct stale or accidentally altered integration assertions.
